# GodotShaders Portal Shaders — CC0 code-only staging

This folder contains shader source code only. It is a shared asset-library package and is **not automatically connected to gameplay**.

## `portal_2d.gdshader`
- Title: 2D portal shader
- Author: HexagonNico
- Source: https://godotshaders.com/shader/2d-portal-shader/
- Engine family: Godot 4 / CanvasItem shader
- License for code: CC0 1.0 Universal
- Purpose: animated noisy/pixelated 2D portal opening with configurable inner rectangle and motion.

## `pixelated_stencil_portal.gdshader`
- Title: Pixelated Portal
- Author: null_builds
- Source: https://godotshaders.com/shader/pixelated-portal/
- Engine family: Godot 4 / Spatial stencil shader
- License for code: CC0 1.0 Universal
- Purpose: stencil-mask portal surface suitable as a basis for 3D portal rendering.

## Import policy
- Only shader source code is copied from the CC0 code snippets.
- Page screenshots, videos, preview images and unrelated page assets are not included.
- No project scene, autoload, gameplay script or `project.godot` setting is modified by this package.
